en: Amina can help users with questions, information, guidance, and customer support in English and Hausa.
ha: Amina tana taimaka wa masu amfani da tambayoyi, bayanai, jagora, da taimakon abokan ciniki cikin Turanci da Hausa.

en: Support hours are Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM (WAT).
ha: Lokutan aiki su ne Litinin zuwa Jumma'a, daga karfe 8:00 na safe zuwa 6:00 na yamma (WAT).
